article_content: A groundbreaking new treatment has enabled five individuals who suffered severe strokes to recover their ability to speak and move. These stroke patients demonstrated significant recovery after undergoing an innovative treatment. According to British research published today, five individuals with severe strokes regained speech, arm and leg function, and improved cognitive abilities within just six months. The study involved three men and two women, aged 45 to 75, who received stem cell therapy using their own bone marrow – a first-of-its-kind experiment. Developed by scientists at Imperial College London, the treatment is believed to be highly effective because it stimulates the rapid regeneration of brain cells damaged by stroke. Annually, over 150,000 people in England experience a stroke, often leading to paralysis, speech impairments, and personality changes, with many facing permanent disability. Researchers caution that this treatment is in its preliminary stages and requires extensive testing on a larger scale to confirm its success, but initial results indicate substantial promise for stroke patient care. Dr. Soma Banerjee, the lead researcher, stated, ‘This pilot study with five patients is indeed small, but the results are very encouraging and serve as a foundation for further investigation.’ She added, ‘This marks the initial step in applying basic scientific discoveries to clinical practice for our patients.’ ‘Significant neurological and clinical improvements were observed in all patients.’ Each of the five participants had experienced severe ischemic strokes, caused by a blocked artery to the brain. This blockage deprives brain cells of oxygen, leading to cell death and severe motor impairments, such as facial drooping, limb paralysis, and difficulties in speaking and swallowing. Four of the five patients had suffered a total anterior circulation stroke, the most critical type, where the entire blood supply to the front of one brain hemisphere is cut off. The prognosis for this stroke type is typically poor: about 50% of patients die within six months, and another 46% become dependent on care. Only 4% achieve independent living. The treatment, developed at Imperial College London, is thought to be highly effective due to its ability to trigger rapid brain cell regeneration in stroke-affected areas. In England, over 150,000 strokes occur annually, causing paralysis and speech problems. The three men and two women, aged 45 to 75, were treated using stem cells from their bone marrow. All participants had suffered severe ischemic strokes. The therapy uses CD34+ stem cells, found in bone marrow, which promote blood cell and blood vessel regeneration. Seven days post-stroke, a bone marrow sample was taken from the hip to isolate stem cells. These cells were then injected directly into the brain via an artery in the groin. The treatment initiates rapid regeneration of stroke-damaged brain cells. In the trial, 75% of patients regained sufficient bodily control to live independently within six months, managing tasks like washing, dressing, eating, personal hygiene, and walking. The treatment is in early development and requires years of further testing before becoming standard care for stroke patients. However, in this trial, 75% of patients achieved independent living within six months. Dr. Banerjee noted, ‘They could walk and care for themselves. They could manage personal care and mobility, achieving independence.’ Published in the journal Stem Cells Translational Medicine, these promising results come with important caveats. The study primarily aimed to confirm treatment safety, which it did, but a sample of five patients is insufficient to conclusively prove effectiveness. The therapy utilizes CD34+ stem cells to stimulate tissue and vessel regrowth, rather than becoming brain cells themselves. Prior animal research suggests that CD34+ cell treatment significantly improves stroke recovery. Patients were treated within seven days of a severe stroke, earlier than in most stem cell trials which often treat patients after six months or more. Following patient or family consent, bone marrow was extracted from the hip for stem cell isolation. The stem cells were then administered directly to the brain via groin artery injection. At least seven more years of research are needed before hospital availability, and extensive patient trials are necessary to confirm success. Nonetheless, scientists are optimistic about its potential. Professor Nagy Habib, a researcher on the project, commented, ‘These early findings are encouraging and warrant further investigation.’ He added, ‘Our scientific lab evidence supports these clinical findings, and we aim to develop a stem cell-derived drug for immediate stroke treatment in emergency rooms, potentially improving patient outcomes by reducing therapy onset time.’ Dr. Madina Kara, Neuroscientist at The Stroke Association, remarked, ‘This is a very exciting development in stroke research, though stem cell research is still in its early stages. These findings could lead to future stroke treatments.’ Dr. Tim Chico, consultant cardiologist at the University of Sheffield, cautioned, ‘It’s crucial to understand that this study is a very preliminary step toward a possible new stroke treatment and doesn’t confirm that stem cell therapy improved patient recovery.’ ‘A much larger study comparing stem cell treatment to no treatment is necessary. Anyone witnessing the impact of stroke will be encouraged by ongoing efforts to find new treatments for this devastating condition.’
translated_content: एक अभूतपूर्व नयाँ उपचारले गम्भीर स्ट्रोक भएका पाँच व्यक्तिहरूलाई बोल्ने र हिँड्ने क्षमता पुन: प्राप्त गर्न सक्षम बनाएको छ। यी स्ट्रोक बिरामीहरूले एक नवीन उपचार गराएपछि उल्लेखनीय सुधार देखाए। आज प्रकाशित बेलायती अनुसन्धान अनुसार, गम्भीर स्ट्रोक भएका पाँच व्यक्तिहरूले छ महिनाभित्रै बोली, हात र खुट्टाको कार्य, र सुधारिएको संज्ञानात्मक क्षमताहरू पुन: प्राप्त गरे। अध्ययनमा ४५ देखि ७५ वर्ष उमेरका तीन पुरुष र दुई महिलाहरू समावेश थिए, जसले आफ्नै अस्थि मज्जा प्रयोग गरेर स्टेम सेल थेरापी प्राप्त गरे - यो पहिलो प्रकारको प्रयोग हो। इम्पेरियल कलेज लन्डनका वैज्ञानिकहरूले विकास गरेको, यो उपचार अत्यधिक प्रभावकारी मानिन्छ किनभने यसले स्ट्रोकले क्षतिग्रस्त भएको मस्तिष्क कोशिकाहरूको द्रुत पुनर्जननलाई उत्तेजित गर्दछ। प्रत्येक वर्ष, इङ्गल्याण्डमा १,५०,००० भन्दा बढी मानिसहरूलाई स्ट्रोक हुन्छ, जसले प्रायः पक्षाघात, बोली बिग्रने र व्यक्तित्व परिवर्तनहरू निम्त्याउँछ, धेरैले स्थायी असक्षमताको सामना गर्छन्। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले चेतावनी दिएका छन् कि यो उपचार प्रारम्भिक चरणमा छ र यसको सफलता पुष्टि गर्न ठूलो मात्रामा परीक्षण आवश्यक छ, तर प्रारम्भिक परिणामहरूले स्ट्रोक बिरामीहरूको हेरचाहको लागि पर्याप्त आशा देखाउँछन्। प्रमुख अनुसन्धानकर्ता डा. सोमा बनर्जीले भने, ‘पाँच बिरामीहरूको यो पायलट अध्ययन सानो भए तापनि, परिणामहरू धेरै उत्साहजनक छन् र थप अनुसन्धानको लागि आधारको रूपमा काम गर्दछ।’ उनले थपे, ‘यसले हाम्रा बिरामीहरूको लागि आधारभूत वैज्ञानिक खोजहरूलाई क्लिनिकल अभ्यासमा लागू गर्ने प्रारम्भिक कदमलाई जनाउँछ।’ ‘सबै बिरामीहरूमा महत्वपूर्ण स्नायविक र क्लिनिकल सुधारहरू अवलोकन गरियो।’ पाँच सहभागीहरूमध्ये प्रत्येकले गम्भीर इस्केमिक स्ट्रोक अनुभव गरेका थिए, जुन मस्तिष्कमा रगत पुर्‍याउने धमनी अवरुद्ध भएर भएको थियो। यो अवरोधले मस्तिष्क कोशिकाहरूलाई अक्सिजनबाट वञ्चित गर्दछ, जसले कोशिका मृत्यु र गम्भीर मोटर हानिहरू निम्त्याउँछ, जस्तै अनुहार लत्रनु, अंग पक्षाघात, र बोल्न र निल्न कठिनाइहरू। पाँच बिरामीहरूमध्ये चारलाई कुल एन्टेरियर सर्कुलेशन स्ट्रोक भएको थियो, सबैभन्दा गम्भीर प्रकार, जहाँ मस्तिष्कको एक गोलार्धको अगाडिको भागमा रगत आपूर्ति पूर्ण रूपमा बन्द हुन्छ। यस प्रकारको स्ट्रोकको लागि पूर्वानुमान सामान्यतया खराब हुन्छ: लगभग ५०% बिरामीहरू छ महिनाभित्र मर्छन्, र अर्को ४६% हेरचाहमा निर्भर हुन्छन्। केवल ४% स्वतन्त्र जीवनयापन प्राप्त गर्छन्। इम्पेरियल कलेज लन्डनमा विकसित गरिएको उपचार, स्ट्रोक प्रभावित क्षेत्रहरूमा द्रुत मस्तिष्क कोशिका पुनर्जननलाई ट्रिगर गर्ने क्षमताको कारण अत्यधिक प्रभावकारी मानिन्छ। इङ्गल्याण्डमा, प्रति वर्ष १,५०,००० भन्दा बढी स्ट्रोकहरू हुन्छन्, जसले पक्षाघात र बोली समस्याहरू निम्त्याउँछ। ४५ देखि ७५ वर्ष उमेरका तीन पुरुष र दुई महिलाहरूलाई तिनीहरूको अस्थि मज्जाबाट स्टेम सेलहरू प्रयोग गरेर उपचार गरियो। सबै सहभागीहरूले गम्भीर इस्केमिक स्ट्रोकहरू भोगेका थिए। थेरापीले CD34+ स्टेम सेलहरू प्रयोग गर्दछ, जुन अस्थि मज्जामा पाइन्छ, जसले रक्त कोशिका र रक्त नली पुनर्जननलाई बढावा दिन्छ। स्ट्रोक भएको सात दिनपछि, स्टेम सेलहरू अलग गर्न हिपबाट अस्थि मज्जाको नमूना लिइएको थियो। यी कोशिकाहरूलाई त्यसपछि ग्रोइनमा धमनी मार्फत मस्तिष्कमा सिधै इन्जेक्सन दिइयो। उपचारले स्ट्रोक-क्षतिग्रस्त मस्तिष्क कोशिकाहरूको द्रुत पुनर्जनन सुरु गर्दछ। परीक्षणमा, ७५% बिरामीहरूले छ महिनाभित्र स्वतन्त्र रूपमा जीवनयापन गर्न पर्याप्त शारीरिक नियन्त्रण पुन: प्राप्त गरे, जसमा नुहाउने, लुगा लगाउने, खाने, व्यक्तिगत सरसफाइ, र हिँड्ने जस्ता कार्यहरू व्यवस्थापन गरे। उपचार प्रारम्भिक विकासमा छ र स्ट्रोक बिरामीहरूको लागि मानक हेरचाह बन्नु अघि थप वर्षौं परीक्षण आवश्यक छ। यद्यपि, यस परीक्षणमा, ७५% बिरामीहरूले छ महिनाभित्र स्वतन्त्र जीवनयापन प्राप्त गरे। डा. बनर्जीले उल्लेख गरे, ‘उनीहरू हिँड्न र आफ्नो हेरचाह गर्न सक्थे। उनीहरूले व्यक्तिगत हेरचाह र गतिशीलता व्यवस्थापन गर्न सक्थे, स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त गर्दै।’ जर्नल स्टेम सेल्स ट्रान्सलेशनल मेडिसिनमा प्रकाशित, यी आशाजनक परिणामहरू महत्त्वपूर्ण सावधानीहरूसँग आउँछन्। अध्ययनले मुख्यतया उपचार सुरक्षा पुष्टि गर्ने लक्ष्य राखेको थियो, जुन यसले गर्‍यो, तर पाँच बिरामीहरूको नमूना प्रभावकारितालाई निर्णायक रूपमा प्रमाणित गर्न अपर्याप्त छ। थेरापीले CD34+ स्टेम सेलहरूलाई तन्तु र नली पुन: वृद्धि गर्न उत्तेजित गर्दछ, बरु मस्तिष्क कोशिकाहरू आफैं बन्ने भन्दा। पशु अनुसन्धानले सुझाव दिन्छ कि CD34+ सेल उपचारले स्ट्रोक रिकभरीलाई उल्लेखनीय रूपमा सुधार गर्दछ। बिरामीहरूलाई गम्भीर स्ट्रोक भएको सात दिनभित्र उपचार गरिएको थियो, धेरैजसो स्टेम सेल परीक्षणहरू भन्दा पहिले जसले प्रायः बिरामीहरूलाई छ महिना वा पछि उपचार गर्दछ। बिरामी वा परिवारको सहमतिपछि, स्टेम सेल आइसोलेसनको लागि हिपबाट अस्थि मज्जा निकालिएको थियो। स्टेम सेलहरूलाई त्यसपछि ग्रोइन धमनी इन्जेक्सन मार्फत मस्तिष्कमा सिधै प्रशासित गरियो। अस्पताल उपलब्धता अघि कम्तिमा सात वर्ष थप अनुसन्धान आवश्यक छ, र सफलता पुष्टि गर्न व्यापक बिरामी परीक्षणहरू आवश्यक छन्। यद्यपि, वैज्ञानिकहरू यसको सम्भावनाको बारेमा आशावादी छन्। अनुसन्धान परियोजनामा अनुसन्धानकर्ता प्रोफेसर नागी हबिबले टिप्पणी गरे, ‘यी प्रारम्भिक निष्कर्षहरू उत्साहजनक छन् र थप अनुसन्धानको वारेन्टी दिन्छ।’ उनले थपे, ‘हाम्रो वैज्ञानिक प्रयोगशाला प्रमाणले यी क्लिनिकल निष्कर्षहरूलाई समर्थन गर्दछ, र हामी आपतकालीन कोठाहरूमा तत्काल स्ट्रोक उपचारको लागि स्टेम सेल-व्युत्पन्न औषधि विकास गर्ने लक्ष्य राख्छौं, जसले थेरापी सुरु हुने समय घटाएर बिरामीको नतिजा सुधार गर्न सक्छ।’ स्ट्रोक एसोसिएसनका न्यूरोसाइंटिस्ट डा. मदिना काराले टिप्पणी गरे, ‘यो स्ट्रोक अनुसन्धानमा धेरै उत्साहजनक विकास हो, यद्यपि स्टेम सेल अनुसन्धान अझै प्रारम्भिक चरणमा छ। यी निष्कर्षहरूले भविष्यको स्ट्रोक उपचारको नेतृत्व गर्न सक्छ।’ शेफिल्ड विश्वविद्यालयका कन्सल्टेन्ट कार्डियोलोजिस्ट डा. टिम चिकोले चेतावनी दिए, ‘यो बुझ्न महत्त्वपूर्ण छ कि यो अध्ययन सम्भावित नयाँ स्ट्रोक उपचारतर्फ एकदम प्रारम्भिक कदम हो र स्टेम सेल थेरापीले बिरामीको रिकभरीमा सुधार गरेको पुष्टि गर्दैन।’ ‘स्टेम सेल उपचारलाई कुनै उपचार नभएकोसँग तुलना गर्ने धेरै ठूलो अध्ययन आवश्यक छ। स्ट्रोकको प्रभाव देख्ने जो कोही पनि यस विनाशकारी अवस्थाको उपचार गर्न नयाँ तरिकाहरू खोज्ने निरन्तर प्रयासहरूबाट प्रोत्साहित हुनेछन्।’

article_content: An anonymous food critic has spent the past two years travelling the UK in search of the perfect full English. The amateur reviewer's opinions have become so well respected that the sought-after stickers he rewards for a good review are displayed like Michelin stars in restaurants. The Fry Up Inspector, as he is known on his blog, rewards restaurants, cafes and tea rooms with a sticker printed with 'Inspector recommended' if he awards a breakfast a score of 8.5 or higher. A secret reviewer has been travelling the UK sampling Britain's favourite breakfast, the full English. Pictured here is Louis' Deli, Norwich, which received nine out of ten in a rave review. The self-appointed taste tester is no stranger to the full English, having rated over 300 breakfasts from across the country. The inspector publishes his reviews on his blog, which has attracted more than 750,000 views since he started it. The faceless diner started his quest for the perfect breakfast after a particularly bad and overpriced offering at a chain hotel. Since then, his dedication has seen him post a review, complete with his own photos, every time he eats his morning meal out. The reviewer began his mission in his hometown of Norwich and has since sampled fry-ups in London, Northampton, Cambridge, Brighton and Bristol. His devotion to dining has even led him to try other breakfast items overseas. The hard-to-please reviewer has even sampled Parisian versions of his favourite morning meal. The Fry Up Inspector has given twelve of his best reviews to restaurants in his hometown of Norwich, such as the Street Cafe, Norwich, which was rated a nine out of ten. Although the inspector has consumed almost a year's worth of the fried dish, he claims that he has maintained a slim physique. The middle-aged man says that he prefers to stick to a diet of fish and steamed vegetables during the week and only indulges in a fried breakfast at weekends. Despite his packed schedule, The Fry Up Inspector fits in his day job working with adults with learning difficulties, and his reviews serve purely as a hobby. The critic says that when it comes to a good review it isn't just down to taste; he likes to feel welcomed by the staff and for the restaurant to have a good atmosphere. Pictured here is the breakfast at Bill's in Brighton, which received a score of 8.5/10. His success could be down to his involvement in the subject, as he argues that so many other restaurant reviews are completely impersonal. 'I was getting frustrated as other websites reviewing breakfasts had so little information on them. 'I wanted to write something far more detailed to make sure people would know when places were open for breakfast, what was on the menu and what the experience was like. 'I learnt that a lot of people go out for breakfast at least a couple of times a month and with so many places to choose from it can be a bit of a gamble, so my blog helps them locate the places that are going to be good. 'I think I must have hit a gap in the market. I do push it on social media, but I think it's also down to growing a fan base.' Not impressed: The Bowthorpe shopping centre cafe only received 3.5/10 (left) and Cafe 6. Rendezvous, Norwich, received a poor 2/10. The inspector judges each breakfast on six key aspects: first impressions, service, ingredients, presentation, taste and value. To reach a final score for the breakfast, the inspector adds together each individual score for the six elements and averages them out. When it comes to rewarding a restaurant with a good review, he looks for a great atmosphere and friendly waiters. 'I want simplicity in the ordering process. I also think about the vibe of the place. 'You could have the most amazing breakfast in the world, but if the staff are rude and make you feel like you shouldn't be there then you don't have a good experience.' Restaurants that receive an 8.5 or more are able to request one of The Food Inspector's much sought after Inspector Recommended stickers. When reviewing taste, the critic has a meticulous process and doesn't let any mistake go unnoticed. 'I focus on how it's cooked, anything that's not quite right, items that don't have any flavour. 'My wife prefers a vegetarian breakfast. This is quite handy as I can get a photo of the veggie breakfast too.' Restaurants can expect a negative review if staff are unwelcoming, use crockery that has seen better days or get his order wrong. Any breakfast which scores 8.5 or higher means the establishment can contact his blog to ask for one of his circular recommended stickers. For the Norwich-born reviewer, it appears that when it comes to a good breakfast there is no place like home, with 12 restaurants bestowed with the sticker in his hometown in the past two years. His best reviews have dished out compliments such as 'out of this world' and 'cooked perfectly.' Some restaurants have not received the same flattery and can probably expect a dip in sales, being described as 'a sorry sight' and compared with 'chewing on foam'.

दिने खोजिएको स्टिकर रेस्टुरेन्टहरूमा मिशेलिन ताराहरू जस्तै प्रदर्शन गरिन्छ। फ्राई अप इन्स्पेक्टर, जसलाई उनको ब्लगमा चिनिन्छ, रेस्टुरेन्ट, क्याफे र चिया घरहरूलाई 'इन्स्पेक्टर सिफारिस गरिएको' छापिएको स्टिकरले पुरस्कृत गर्दछ यदि उनले नास्तालाई ८.५ वा उच्च अंक दिए भने। एक गोप्य समीक्षक बेलायतको मनपर्ने नास्ता, फुल इंग्लिशको नमूना संकलन गर्दै बेलायतभरि यात्रा गरिरहेका छन्। यहाँ लुइस डेली, नर्विचको तस्वीर छ, जसले उत्कृष्ट समीक्षामा दश मध्ये नौ अंक प्राप्त गर्‍यो। स्वतः नियुक्त स्वाद परीक्षक फुल इंग्लिशका लागि नौलो छैनन्, उनले देश भरका ३०० भन्दा बढी नास्ताहरूको मूल्याङ्कन गरेका छन्। निरीक्षकले आफ्नो ब्लगमा आफ्नो समीक्षा प्रकाशित गर्दछ, जसले उनले सुरु गरेदेखि ७५०,००० भन्दा बढी पटक हेरिएको छ। अनुहार नभएको भोजनालयले चेन होटलमा विशेष गरी खराब र महँगो नास्ता खाएपछि उत्तम नास्ताको लागि आफ्नो खोजी सुरु गर्‍यो। त्यसपछि, उनको समर्पणले उनलाई हरेक पटक बिहानको खाना बाहिर खाँदा आफ्नै फोटोसहितको समीक्षा पोस्ट गरेको देखियो। समीक्षकले आफ्नो मिशन आफ्नो गृहनगर नर्विचमा सुरु गरे र त्यसपछि लन्डन, नर्थम्प्टन, क्याम्ब्रिज, ब्राइटन र ब्रिस्टलमा फ्राई-अपहरूको नमूना लिएका छन्। भोजनमा उनको भक्तिले उनलाई विदेशमा अन्य नास्ता वस्तुहरू प्रयास गर्न पनि प्रेरित गरेको छ। गाह्रो मान्ने समीक्षकले आफ्नो मनपर्ने बिहानको खानाको पेरिसियन संस्करणहरूको पनि नमूना लिएका छन्। फ्राई अप इन्स्पेक्टरले नर्विचको स्ट्रीट क्याफे, नर्विच जस्ता रेस्टुरेन्टहरूलाई आफ्नो गृहनगर नर्विचमा १२ उत्कृष्ट समीक्षाहरू दिएका छन्, जसलाई दश मध्ये नौ अंक दिइएको थियो। निरीक्षकले लगभग एक वर्षको फ्राइड डिश खाए पनि, उनले दावी गर्छन् कि उनले पातलो शरीर कायम राखेका छन्। मध्य-उमेरका मानिस भन्छन् कि उनी हप्ताको समयमा माछा र भापयुक्त तरकारीको आहारमा रहन रुचाउँछन् र सप्ताहन्तमा मात्र फ्राइड नास्ता खान्छन्। उनको व्यस्त तालिकाको बाबजुद, फ्राई अप इन्स्पेक्टरले सिकाइ कठिनाइ भएका वयस्कहरूसँग काम गर्ने आफ्नो दैनिक कामलाई समय दिन्छन्, र उनको समीक्षाहरू विशुद्ध रूपमा शौकको रूपमा सेवा गर्दछन्। समीक्षक भन्छन् कि जब राम्रो समीक्षाको कुरा आउँछ यो केवल स्वादमा मात्र निर्भर हुँदैन; उनी कर्मचारीहरूले स्वागत गरेको र रेस्टुरेन्टमा राम्रो वातावरण भएको महसुस गर्न चाहन्छन्। यहाँ ब्राइटन ८.५/१० मा बिलको नास्ताको तस्वीर छ, जसले नौ आउट अफ टेन पनि पायो। उनको सफलता विषयमा उनको संलग्नताको कारण हुन सक्छ, किनकि उनले तर्क गर्छन् कि अन्य धेरै रेस्टुरेन्ट समीक्षाहरू पूर्ण रूपमा अवैयक्तिक छन्। 'म निराश भइरहेको थिएँ किनकि नास्ताको समीक्षा गर्ने अन्य वेबसाइटहरूमा थोरै जानकारी थियो। 'म केहि धेरै विस्तृत लेख्न चाहान्थे ताकि मानिसहरूलाई थाहा होस् कि ठाउँहरू नास्ताको लागि कहिले खुल्छन्, मेनुमा के छ र अनुभव कस्तो थियो। 'मैले थाहा पाएँ कि धेरै मानिसहरू महिनामा कम्तिमा दुई पटक नास्ता खान्छन् र छनौट गर्न धेरै ठाउँहरू भएकोले यो अलिकति जुवा हुन सक्छ, त्यसैले मेरो ब्लगले उनीहरूलाई राम्रो हुने ठाउँहरू पत्ता लगाउन मद्दत गर्दछ। 'मलाई लाग्छ कि मैले बजारमा खाली ठाउँ भेट्टाएको हुनुपर्छ। म यसलाई सोशल मिडियामा प्रवर्द्धन गर्छु, तर मलाई लाग्छ कि यो फ्यान बेस बढाउनु पनि हो।' प्रभावित भएन: बोथर्प शपिंग सेन्टर क्याफेले मात्र ३.५/१० (बायाँ) र क्याफे ६. रेन्डेजभस, नर्विचले खराब २/१० पाए। निरीक्षकले प्रत्येक नास्तालाई छवटा मुख्य पक्षहरूमा मूल्याङ्कन गर्दछ: पहिलो प्रभाव, सेवा, सामग्री, प्रस्तुतीकरण, स्वाद र मूल्य। नास्ताको लागि अन्तिम स्कोरमा पुग्न, निरीक्षकले छवटा तत्वहरूको लागि प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत स्कोरहरू सँगै जोड्छन् र तिनीहरूलाई औसत निकाल्छन्। जब राम्रो समीक्षाको साथ रेस्टुरेन्टलाई पुरस्कृत गर्ने कुरा आउँछ, उनी उत्कृष्ट वातावरण र मिलनसार वेटरहरू खोज्छन्। 'म अर्डर गर्ने प्रक्रियामा सरलता चाहन्छु। म ठाउँको वातावरणको बारेमा पनि सोच्छु। 'तपाईंसँग संसारको सबैभन्दा अद्भुत नास्ता हुन सक्छ, तर यदि कर्मचारीहरू असभ्य छन् र तपाईंलाई त्यहाँ हुनु हुँदैन जस्तो महसुस गराउँछन् भने तपाईंसँग राम्रो अनुभव हुँदैन।' ८.५ वा बढी प्राप्त गर्ने रेस्टुरेन्टहरूले खाद्य निरीक्षकको धेरै खोजिएको निरीक्षक सिफारिस गरिएको स्टिकरहरू मध्ये एक अनुरोध गर्न सक्षम छन्। स्वादको समीक्षा गर्दा, समीक्षकसँग एक सावधानीपूर्वक प्रक्रिया हुन्छ र कुनै पनि गल्तीलाई बेवास्ता गर्न दिँदैन। 'म यो कसरी पकाइएको छ, केहि जुन एकदम सही छैन, स्वाद नभएका वस्तुहरूमा ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्छु। 'मेरी श्रीमतीलाई शाकाहारी नास्ता मन पर्छ। यो एकदम उपयोगी छ किनकि म शाकाहारी नास्ताको फोटो पनि लिन सक्छु।' रेस्टुरेन्टहरूले नकारात्मक समीक्षाको आशा गर्न सक्छन् यदि कर्मचारीहरू अप्रिय छन्, धेरै पुरानो क्रोकरी प्रयोग गर्छन् वा उनको अर्डर गलत गर्छन् भने। कुनै पनि नास्ता जसले ८.५ वा उच्च अंक प्राप्त गर्दछ त्यसको अर्थ त्यो प्रतिष्ठानले उनको गोलाकार सिफारिस गरिएको स्टिकरहरू मध्ये एकको लागि सोध्न उनको ब्लगमा सम्पर्क गर्न सक्छ। नर्विचमा जन्मेका समीक्षकका लागि, यो देखिन्छ कि जब राम्रो नास्ताको कुरा आउँछ तब घर जस्तो ठाउँ छैन, पछिल्लो दुई वर्षमा उनको गृहनगरमा १२ रेस्टुरेन्टहरूलाई स्टिकर दिइएको छ। उनको उत्कृष्ट समीक्षाहरूले 'संसारबाट बाहिर' र 'पूर्ण रूपमा पकाइएको' जस्ता प्रशंसाहरू दिएका छन्। केही रेस्टुरेन्टहरूले त्यही चापलूसी पाएका छैनन् र सायद 'दुःखद दृश्य' को रूपमा वर्णन गरिएको र 'फोम चपाउनु' सँग तुलना गरिएकोले बिक्रीमा गिरावटको आशा गर्न सक्छन्।

article_content: Days after India conceded a heartbreaking six-wicket loss against Australia in the ODI World Cup 2023 at Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, former 'Men in Blue' batter Ambati Rayudu blamed the pitch conditions for the loss. While speaking to BeerBicep's YouTube channel, Rayudu questioned whose idea it was to prepare a slow pitch for the final. He added that a normal surface would have been more interesting because, to him, India was stronger than the Aussies. "Even the wicket was very slow and lethargic for a final. I don't know whose idea it was. I think even a normal surface would have done because we were way stronger than the Australian side. We didn't have to do all that in the final. It was just supposed to be a good cricketing wicket, which, unfortunately, it wasn't," Rayudu said. The former Chennai Super Kings player added that some people thought they were making it easier for India by preparing a slow pitch. He then said that Rohit Sharma's side got stuck due to the slow wicket in Ahmedabad. "Some people think that they are helping the Indian side by preparing such a wicket. We got stuck on a wicket that was so slow. I don't think that should happen. It should be a good cricketing wicket. We have the skill and strength in our side to beat any side. A pitch remaining consistent throughout 100 overs is an ideal scenario in a limited-overs game. The toss shouldn't matter that much," he added. He further added that if someone made such a pitch on purpose then it was stupidity. "I don't know if somebody has thought about it or done it on purpose. If they had done it on purpose, it's stupidity. But I don't think they would have done it," he added. Coming to the match, India struggled on a tough batting surface after Australia elected to field first, with fifties coming from KL Rahul (66) and Virat Kohli (54). India was bundled out for 240 in their 50 overs. In the chase of 241, Travis Head (137) and Marnus Labuschagne (58*) guided Australia to their sixth WC title at Ahmedabad's Narendra Modi Stadium. किनभने, उनको विचारमा, भारत अस्ट्रेलियाभन्दा बलियो थियो। "फाइनलको लागि विकेट धेरै सुस्त र कमजोर थियो। मलाई थाहा छैन यो कसको विचार थियो। मलाई लाग्छ कि सामान्य सतहले पनि काम गर्ने थियो किनभने हामी article_content: A recent national poll indicates that while the war in Afghanistan remains largely unpopular among Americans, a majority support President Obama's decision to deploy additional U.S. troops. The CNN/Opinion Research Corp. survey, released Wednesday, revealed that 59 percent of respondents favor sending 30,000 more troops to Afghanistan. Conversely, 39 percent are against this plan. CNN Polling Director Keating Holland noted that many opponents of Obama's troop increase would prefer an immediate withdrawal of all U.S. forces from Afghanistan. The poll also highlighted that overall public sentiment is against the war itself, with 55 percent opposing the U.S. mission in Afghanistan and 43 percent supporting it. Holland elaborated that 30 percent of those surveyed have opposed the war since its inception, while another 25 percent initially supported the war in 2001 but now oppose it. Only 18 percent of respondents believe the U.S. is currently winning in Afghanistan, and two-thirds think neither side is winning. Holland suggested that support for Obama's troop plan might stem from a perceived need for more troops to achieve victory, while overall war opposition could be due to Americans' aversion to losing. The survey also identified a racial disparity in opinions on the war. White respondents were divided, whereas 70 percent of black respondents expressed opposition to the war. A prior CNN/Opinion Research Corp. poll from November 24 showed 45 percent support and 52 percent opposition to the Afghanistan war. The latest poll, conducted from December 16-20, questioned 1,160 adult Americans, including 259 African-Americans and 786 whites, via telephone. The sampling error is plus or minus 3 percentage points. CNN Deputy Political Director Paul Steinhauser contributed to this report.
translated_content: हालैको राष्ट्रिय सर्वेक्षणले देखाउँछ कि अफगानिस्तानमा युद्ध अझै पनि धेरै अमेरिकीहरूमाझ अलोकप्रिय रहे पनि, धेरैले राष्ट्रपति ओबामाको थप अमेरिकी सेनाहरू तैनाथ गर्ने निर्णयलाई समर्थन गर्छन्। बुधवार जारी गरिएको CNN/ओपिनियन रिसर्च कर्प सर्वेक्षणले ५९ प्रतिशत उत्तरदाताहरूले अफगानिस्तानमा थप ३०,००० सेना पठाउने पक्षमा रहेको खुलासा गरेको छ। यसको विपरीत, ३९ प्रतिशत यस योजनाको विपक्षमा छन्। CNN मतदान निर्देशक किटिंग होल्यान्डले उल्लेख गरे कि ओबामाको सेना वृद्धि योजनाका धेरै विरोधीहरू अफगानिस्तानबाट सबै अमेरिकी सेनाहरूको तत्काल फिर्ता चाहन्छन्। सर्वेक्षणले यो पनि हाइलाइट गर्‍यो कि समग्र सार्वजनिक भावना युद्धको विपक्षमा छ, ५५ प्रतिशतले अफगानिस्तानमा अमेरिकी मिशनको विरोध गरेका छन् र ४३ प्रतिशतले समर्थन गरेका छन्। हल्यान्डले विस्तृत रूपमा बताए कि सर्वेक्षण गरिएका मध्ये ३० प्रतिशतले युद्धको शुरुवातदेखि नै विरोध गरेका छन्, जबकि अर्को २५ प्रतिशतले सुरुमा २००१ मा युद्धलाई समर्थन गरे तर अहिले विरोध गर्छन्। उत्तरदाताहरू मध्ये केवल १८ प्रतिशतले विश्वास गर्छन् कि अमेरिका हाल अफगानिस्तानमा जितिरहेको छ, र दुई तिहाइले कुनै पनि पक्ष जितिरहेको छैन भन्ने सोच्छन्। हल्यान्डले सुझाव दिए कि ओबामाको सेना योजनाको लागि समर्थन विजय हासिल गर्न थप सेनाहरूको आवश्यकताबाट उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ, जबकि युद्धको समग्र विरोध अमेरिकीहरूको हार्न मन नपराउनुको कारण हुन सक्छ। सर्वेक्षणले युद्धमा रायहरूको जातीय भिन्नता पनि पहिचान गर्‍यो। गोरा उत्तरदाताहरू विभाजित थिए, जबकि ७० प्रतिशत काला उत्तरदाताहरूले युद्धको विरोध व्यक्त गरे। नोभेम्बर २४ को अघिल्लो CNN/ओपिनियन रिसर्च कर्प सर्वेक्षणले अफगानिस्तान युद्धको लागि ४५ प्रतिशत समर्थन र ५२ प्रतिशत विरोध देखाएको थियो। डिसेम्बर १६-२० सम्म गरिएको पछिल्लो सर्वेक्षणले २५९ अफ्रिकी-अमेरिकी र ७८६ गोराहरू सहित १,१६० वयस्क अमेरिकीहरूलाई टेलिफोन मार्फत प्रश्न गरेको थियो। नमूना त्रुटि प्लस वा माइनस ३ प्रतिशत बिन्दु हो। CNN उप राजनीतिक निर्देशक पल स्टेनहाउजरले यस रिपोर्टमा योगदान दिए।

article_content: In Lawrence, Massachusetts, a five-year-old Pomeranian mix named Papi suffered horrific burns in a house fire and required extensive surgery. His owner, Jackelyn Graciano, was also a victim, having been stabbed before her home was intentionally set ablaze. Papi is currently receiving critical care at Angell Animal Medical Center in Boston after being rescued from the fire. Ms. Graciano is also in hospital, recovering from her stab injuries. The brave little dog has already undergone major operations to remove burned tissue from his back and ears, and sadly, his tail had to be amputated due to severe damage. He faces further surgery to repair an injured ankle. Veterinarian Dr. Mike Pavletic, who performed Papi's initial surgery, described the severity of his burns as second and third degree across much of his body. He expressed confidence in the success of the initial surgery, but Papi still requires further treatment, including ankle surgery. The cost of Papi's treatment is expected to reach $10,000, but thankfully, an anonymous donor has generously contributed $6,000. Ms. Graciano expressed her deep distress and longing to reunite with Papi as they both heal. Police have arrested Yohanna Estrella in connection with the incident. Estrella faces serious charges including arson, assault and battery with a dangerous weapon with intent to murder, accused of stabbing Ms. Graciano and setting her house on fire.
translated_content: म्यासाचुसेट्सको लरेन्समा, पापी नामको पाँच वर्षीय पोमेरेनियन मिक्स कुकुर घरको आगोमा भयानक रूपमा जल्यो र व्यापक शल्यक्रिया आवश्यक पर्यो। उसको मालिक ज्याकलिन ग्रासियानो पनि पीडित थिइन्, जसलाई उनको घर जानाजानी जलाउनु अघि छुरा प्रहार गरिएको थियो। आगोबाट उद्धार गरिएपछि पापीलाई अहिले बोस्टनको एन्जेल एनिमल मेडिकल सेन्टरमा गम्भीर हेरचाहमा राखिएको छ। ज्याकलिन ग्रासियानो पनि अस्पतालमा छिन्, र उनको छुरा प्रहारको चोटबाट निको हुँदैछिन्। यो साहसी सानो कुकुरको ढाड र कानबाट जलेको तन्तु हटाउनको लागि पहिले नै ठूलो शल्यक्रिया गरिएको छ, र दुःखको कुरा, उसको पुच्छर गम्भीर क्षति भएका कारण काट्नु परेको थियो। उसलाई घाइते भएको गोलीगाँठो मर्मत गर्न थप शल्यक्रिया गर्नुपर्नेछ। पशु चिकित्सक डा. माइक पाभलेटिक, जसले पापीको प्रारम्भिक शल्यक्रिया गरे, उनको शरीरको धेरै भागमा दोस्रो र तेस्रो डिग्रीको जलन भएको बताए। डा. पाभलेटिकले प्रारम्भिक शल्यक्रियाको सफलतामा विश्वास व्यक्त गरे, तर पापीलाई अझै गोलीगाँठो शल्यक्रिया सहित थप उपचार आवश्यक छ। पापीको उपचारको खर्च $१०,००० पुग्ने अनुमान गरिएको छ, तर सौभाग्यवश, एक अज्ञात दाताले उदारतापूर्वक $६,००० योगदान गरेका छन्। ज्याकलिन ग्रासियानोले आफ्नो गहिरो पीडा र दुवै निको भएपछि पापीसँग पुनर्मिलन हुने चाहना व्यक्त गरिन्। प्रहरीले यो घटनाको सम्बन्धमा योहाना एस्ट्रेललालाई पक्राउ गरेको छ। योहाना एस्ट्रेललाले ज्याकलिन ग्रासियानोलाई छुरा प्रहार गरेको र उनको घरमा आगो लगाएको आरोपमा आगजनी, आक्रमण र खतरनाक हतियारले हत्या गर्ने उद्देश्यले ब्याट्री सहित गम्भीर आरोपहरूको सामना गरिरहेकी छिन्।

article_content: By Louise Eccles PUBLISHED: 17:39 EST, 30 July 2013 | UPDATED: 18:24 EST, 30 July 2013 Out and about: Laura Johnson heads to the gym Last summer, millionaire's daughter Laura Johnson was behind bars for her role as a getaway driver in one of the most serious rampages of the London riots. A year on and the former grammar school prefect seems to be making the most of her freedom, appearing relaxed as she prepared to get behind the wheel of a car and head to the gym. It is a far cry from two years ago when she became 'infatuated' with convicted robber and ‘bad boy’ Emmanuel Okubote, 20. Her trial last May heard how she had shunned her respectable background to embrace an ‘exciting new world’ of cannabis, alcohol and violent gangster rap music. This included acting as a driver for Okubote and his friends as they embarked on a seven-hour crime spree during the riots that scarred the summer of 2011. Miss Johnson, 21, a Straight-A student, was found guilty of burglary and handling stolen goods and jailed for two years. During sentencing, Judge Patricia Lees told her, 'You were pivotal to this planned criminal enterprise.' 'You drove to pick up the rest of the group and willingly remained with them throughout.' 'On your evidence, so much was stolen throughout that night that it necessitated trips to safe addresses where goods could be off-loaded.' She served just seven months in prison before she was released on licence. Miss Johnson, who is not believed to be working at the moment, lives with her parents Robert and Lindsay, who own a direct marketing business, and her two brothers at the family’s £1 million home in Orpington, Kent. Mrs Johnson declined to comment on her daughter’s release from prison. Laura Johnson leaves Inner London Crown Court on March 26 last year. Following her trial in May 2012, she was found guilty of burglary and handling stolen goods and jailed for two years.

article_content: In a momentous presidential election, Barack Obama declared victory, telling his supporters that 'change has come to America'. Addressing a massive crowd in Chicago, Obama acknowledged the challenges ahead but expressed strong hope for the nation's future. He emphasized that progress might take time, yet he was confident that the American people would achieve it together. Obama's projected win marked a historic milestone, making him the first African-American to be elected to the highest office. His opponent, Senator John McCain, gracefully conceded and offered his support to Obama. McCain stated his continued service to the nation and expressed eagerness to collaborate with Obama. President George W. Bush also contacted Obama to congratulate him and invited him to the White House.  Furthermore, the election saw significant gains for the Democratic Party in the Senate, strengthening their majority in Congress. Obama recognized the Democratic victory but called for humility and a commitment to bridging divides to foster progress. Speaking to enthusiastic crowds waving American flags, Obama hailed the victory as 'your victory'. He reached out to those who did not vote for him, pledging to be their president as well and seeking their help.  Supporters celebrated wildly, chanting slogans and expressing joy at the historic outcome. Hillary Clinton, who previously competed with Obama for the Democratic nomination, issued a statement celebrating the historic win and expressing confidence in a better future under Obama's leadership. Senator Ted Kennedy also lauded Obama's vision and the public's embrace of change. Election night results showed Obama winning key states like Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Virginia, the latter being a state that had not voted for a Democrat in presidential elections since 1964. Polls leading up to the election indicated Obama's lead, and voters expressed enthusiasm and national pride. High voter turnout was reported across the country, with some facing long waits to vote. This election concluded the longest presidential campaign in US history, lasting 21 months. Obama, at 47 years old, began his transition to the presidency and was set to be inaugurated as the 44th president on January 20, 2009.
translated_content: एक महत्वपूर्ण राष्ट्रपतीय चुनावमा, बराक ओबामाले विजय घोषणा गरे, आफ्ना समर्थकहरूलाई भने कि 'अमेरिकामा परिवर्तन आएको छ'। शिकागोमा विशाल भीडलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै, ओबामाले आगामी चुनौतीहरू स्वीकार गरे तर राष्ट्रको भविष्यको लागि बलियो आशा व्यक्त गरे। उनले जोड दिए कि प्रगतिमा समय लाग्न सक्छ, तर उनी विश्वस्त थिए कि अमेरिकी जनताले यसलाई सँगै हासिल गर्नेछन्। ओबामाको अनुमानित जीतले ऐतिहासिक माइलस्टोन चिन्हित गर्‍यो, जसले उनलाई सर्वोच्च पदमा निर्वाचित हुने पहिलो अफ्रिकी-अमेरिकी बनायो। उनका प्रतिद्वन्द्वी, सिनेटर जोन म्याक्केनले शालीनतापूर्वक हार स्वीकार गरे र ओबामालाई आफ्नो समर्थन प्रस्ताव गरे। म्याक्केनले राष्ट्रको लागि आफ्नो निरन्तर सेवा बताए र ओबामासँग सहकार्य गर्न उत्सुकता व्यक्त गरे। राष्ट्रपति जर्ज डब्लु बुशले पनि ओबामालाई बधाई दिन र उनलाई व्हाइट हाउसमा आमन्त्रित गर्न सम्पर्क गरे। यसबाहेक, चुनावले सिनेटमा डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टीको लागि महत्वपूर्ण लाभ देख्यो, जसले कांग्रेसमा उनीहरूको बहुमतलाई बलियो बनायो। ओबामाले डेमोक्रेटिक विजयलाई स्वीकार गरे तर प्रगतिलाई बढावा दिन विभाजनहरू कम गर्न नम्रता र प्रतिबद्धताको लागि आह्वान गरे। अमेरिकी झण्डा फहराउँदै उत्साही भीडलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै, ओबामाले विजयलाई 'तपाईंको विजय' भनेर प्रशंसा गरे। उनले आफूलाई भोट नदिनेहरूसम्म पुगे, उनीहरूको राष्ट्रपति बन्ने र उनीहरूको मद्दत खोज्ने वाचा गरे। समर्थकहरूले ऐतिहासिक परिणाममा नाराबाजी गर्दै र खुशी व्यक्त गर्दै खुसी मनाए। हिलेरी क्लिंटन, जसले पहिले डेमोक्रेटिक नामांकनको लागि ओबामासँग प्रतिस्पर्धा गरेकी थिइन्, ऐतिहासिक जीतको उत्सव मनाउँदै र ओबामाको नेतृत्वमा राम्रो भविष्यमा विश्वास व्यक्त गर्दै एक बयान जारी गरिन्। सिनेटर टेड केनेडीले पनि ओबामाको दृष्टिकोण र जनताले परिवर्तनलाई अँगालेकोमा प्रशंसा गरे। चुनाव रातीको नतिजाले ओबामाले पेन्सिलभेनिया, ओहायो र भर्जिनिया जस्ता प्रमुख राज्यहरू जितेको देखायो, पछिल्लो राज्य सन् १९६४ देखि राष्ट्रपतीय चुनावमा डेमोक्र्याटलाई भोट नदिएको राज्य थियो। चुनाव अघिको सर्वेक्षणले ओबामाको अग्रता संकेत गर्‍यो, र मतदाताहरूले उत्साह र राष्ट्रिय गर्व व्यक्त गरे। देशभर उच्च मतदाता उपस्थिति रिपोर्ट गरिएको थियो, केहीले भोट दिन लामो समय पर्खनु परेको थियो। यो चुनावले अमेरिकी इतिहासको सबैभन्दा लामो राष्ट्रपतीय अभियानको समापन गर्‍यो, २१ महिनासम्म चलेको थियो। ४७ वर्षको उमेरमा ओबामाले राष्ट्रपतिको लागि आफ्नो संक्रमण सुरु गरे र २० जनवरी, २००९ मा ४४ औं राष्ट्रपतिको रूपमा शपथ लिने तयारी थियो।

article_content: They began clapping when the hearse bearing the body of Police Constable Nicola Hughes came into view, and they did not stop for almost half an hour. Thousands of police officers, who had travelled from all over the country to pay their respects as the 23-year-old's funeral cortege was led through Manchester, were joined by members of the public. The public had heeded a call from Greater Manchester Police for 'decent people' to stand together with them. The applause for Pc Hughes - described by colleagues as bubbly and always smiling - was followed by steady clapping for the hundreds of officers who followed the procession on foot. Lining the streets, the funeral cortege of killed Pc Nicola Hughes made its way through an eerily quiet Manchester to the city's cathedral. Emotional scenes unfolded as officers walked or stood in a display of sadness for all at Greater Manchester Police. A police officer wiped her eyes as she watched the funeral via a screen in Cathedral Gardens, Manchester, while another cried as the coffin was carried into Manchester Cathedral. The coffin of Police Constable Nicola Hughes was carried into Manchester Cathedral after processing along the city's Deansgate area. Pall-bearers carried the coffin of Pc Nicola Hughes, one of the two policewomen murdered in a gun and grenade attack in Hattersley, Tameside, Manchester, on September 18, into Manchester Cathedral. Colleagues from Greater Manchester Police formed a Guard of Honour at Manchester Cathedral for the funeral of Pc Nicola Hughes, who was killed last month on September 18. Pc Hughes and her colleague Pc Fiona Bone, 32, died after attending what had appeared to be a routine burglary call to a house in Hattersley in Tameside, Greater Manchester, just over two weeks ago on September 18. Police officers provided a guard of honour ahead of the cortege, led by the funeral carriage pulled by six horses from the force’s mounted unit and bearing the coffin, shrouded in black cloth. The crowd applauded as the procession went along Deansgate, until chimes sounded from the cathedral marking the start of a 15-minute silence. The family of Pc Hughes entered the cathedral including her mother, Susan, father, Bryn, and younger brother, Sam. A picture of Pc Nicola Hughes stood beside her coffin at Manchester Cathedral during her funeral service. Greater Manchester Police Chief Constable Sir Peter Fahy addressed mourners at the service. Two police officers cried as the coffin of GMP's Nicola Hughes was carried into Manchester Cathedral. British police reacted emotionally before the funeral of their colleague Pc Nicola Hughes at Manchester Cathedral. Police officers and members of the public stood outside as they watched the funeral of Pc Nicola Hughes. Mounted police officers saluted as the coffin of Pc Nicola Hughes was carried into Manchester Cathedral. Police officers arrived for the funeral service of killed policewoman Nicola Hughes, uniting with the community. The hearse carrying killed policewoman Nicola Hughes was driven from the cathedral after her funeral in Manchester, marking remarkable scenes. The coffin of Greater Manchester Police constable Nicola Hughes was carried from Manchester Cathedral after her funeral service in Manchester, where she was laid to rest. GMP officers acted as pallbearers with her police hat on top of the coffin, which was led in to Pie Jesu, sung by the cathedral choir. Police chaplain Keith Stewart said, 'She was greatly respected and loved by her colleagues who would variously describe her as friendly, full of life, always willing to lend a hand, as keen as mustard, as brave as they come'. Pc Hughes, from Oldham, Greater Manchester, joined GMP in 2009. Her family said she wanted to make a difference and was doing a job she loved. Fellow officers described her as a chatterbox, always smiling, with a bubbly, infectious personality. Officers from forces nationwide volunteered to cover the shifts of GMP colleagues so they could attend the service at Manchester Cathedral, with most of them lining the funeral procession route. Chief constables and senior officers from forces across England and Wales were said to be among the 1,000 mourners inside the cathedral along with Pc Hughes's family, friends and fellow officers. Police officers and members of the public stood outside Manchester Cathedral during the service, united as one. The funeral service of policewoman Nicola Hughes, from Oldham, took place at Manchester Cathedral. Crowds lined the street to pay tribute to the life of Greater Manchester Police's Nicola Hughes in an eerily quiet atmosphere. Police officers gathered for the funeral of policewoman Nicola Hughes in Manchester, following the order of service. Police officers and members of the public lined the streets in Deansgate ahead of the funeral, standing together. A full-size photograph of Pc Hughes was mounted at the front of the church. Some mourners - members of the public and police - wiped away silent tears as the hymns were sung and poems read. GMP chief constable Sir Peter Fahy said, 'Her family were so proud of Nicola. She was a fighter. She will be greatly missed by everyone who knew her. We will never forget her great sacrifice'. The congregation sang the hymns The Lord’s My Shepherd and In Heavenly Love Abiding. Colleagues of Pc Hughes gave poetry and Bible readings. Sergeant Stephen Lovatt read Death Is Nothing At All, Inspector Jane Brown read Don’t Let Your Hearts Be Troubled and Sergeant Gordon Swan read Feel No Guilt In Laughter. Police chaplain Keith Stewart said Pc Hughes was born at the Royal Oldham Hospital in 1988, attended Saddleworth High School and went to Huddersfield University before joining the force. He asked mourners to ‘remember a vibrant young woman’ who was a green belt in karate but also enjoyed looking after her nails and hair and who still had ‘something of the little girl about her’. Police officers gathered for the funeral of murdered policewoman Pc Nicola Hughes in Manchester, remembering her. Children played as police officers lined the streets ahead of the funeral at Manchester Cathedral, showing emotions. A mourner held a police teddy bear, while the Greater Manchester Police flag was at half mast above Manchester Cathedral prior to the funeral, showing respect. Mr Stewart said, ‘She was greatly respected and loved by her colleagues who would variously describe her as friendly, full of life, always willing to lend a hand, as keen as mustard, as brave as they come and a chatterbox.’ Pc Fiona Bone, 32, was also involved as the other female officer killed in the tragic incident. GMP chief constable Sir Peter Fahy said she was ‘incredibly mature’ despite her young years and died from ‘her own devotion to others’. He said her family had spoken of the proud moment when every new officer brings home their uniform for the first time. ‘They (officers) wonder will you be able to fill those boots,’ he said. ‘In Nicola's case, there was never any doubt. She decided not to be a bystander. Nicola and Fiona (Bone) knew that the police service has the same expectations of female officers as male officers.' He said Pc Hughes signed knowing she would put herself in danger and that an unarmed police force was not a ‘tactical option’ but that it was ‘central to our commitment to minimum force’. ‘Nicola, in her dedication and professionalism, in the way she carried out her duties, showed that policing is not about muscle but reason, restraint and intelligence,' he said. ‘Her family were so proud of Nicola. She was a fighter. She will be greatly missed by everyone who knew her. We will never forget her great sacrifice.' A big screen was relaying the funeral at the rear of the cathedral for hundreds gathered outside. Dale Cregan, 29, is currently on remand accused of the murder of both policewomen, father and son David and Mark Short - and four attempted murders. The funeral of Pc Bone will take place at the same venue tomorrow. जनताले स्वीकारेका थिए। सहकर्मीहरूले हँसिलो र सधैं मुस्कुराउने भनेर वर्णन गरेकी पीसी ह्युजेसको लागि ताली पछि सयौं अधिकारीहरूले जुलुसलाई पैदल पछ्याउँदा लगातार ताली बजाइयो। सडकको छेउमा लामबद्ध भएर, मारिएकी पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टि जुलुस डरलाग्दो शान्त म्यानचेस्टर हुँदै शहरको क्याथेड्रलमा गयो। ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर प्रहरीमा सबैको लागि दुःखको दिनमा अधिकारीहरू हिँडे वा उभिएपछि भावनात्मक दृश्यहरू देखा परे। एक प्रहरी अधिकारीले क्याथेड्रल गार्डन, म्यानचेस्टरमा स्क्रिनमा अन्त्येष्टि हेरिरहेको बेला आँसु पुछिन्, जबकि अर्कीले म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा कफिन बोक्दा रोइन्। पुलिस कन्स्टेबल निकोला ह्युजेसको कफिन शहरको डीन्सगेट क्षेत्र हुँदै म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा लगियो। पाल-वाहकहरूले सेप्टेम्बर १८ मा ह्याटर्सले, टेमसाइड, म्यानचेस्टरमा बन्दुक र ग्रेनेड आक्रमणमा मारिएका दुई महिला प्रहरीमध्ये एक पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको कफिन म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा बोके। ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर पुलिसका सहकर्मीहरूले म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टिका लागि गार्ड अफ अनर बनाए, जो गत महिना सेप्टेम्बर १८ मा मारिएकी थिइन्। पीसी ह्युजेस र उनकी सहकर्मी पीसी फियोना बोन, ३२, सेप्टेम्बर १८ मा टेमसाइड, ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टरको ह्याटर्सलेको एउटा घरमा नियमित चोरीको कल भएको जस्तो देखिएको ठाउँमा गएपछि मृत्यु भयो। प्रहरी अधिकारीहरूले कफिन बोकेको शव वाहनलाई कालो कपडाले ढाकेर बलको माउन्टेड युनिटका छ वटा घोडाले तानेको अन्त्येष्टि गाडीको नेतृत्वमा जुलुस अघि गार्ड अफ अनर प्रदान गरे। डीन्सगेट हुँदै जुलुस जाँदा भीडले ताली बजायो, क्याथेड्रलबाट १५ मिनेट मौन धारण सुरु भएको जनाउ दिने घण्टी नबजेसम्म। पीसी ह्युजेसको परिवार उनकी आमा, सुसान, बुबा, ब्रायन र कान्छो भाइ, सामसहित क्याथेड्रलमा प्रवेश गरे। म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा उनको अन्त्येष्टि सेवाको क्रममा पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको तस्वीर उनको कफिनको छेउमा राखिएको थियो। ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर पुलिसका प्रमुख कन्स्टेबल सर पिटर फहीले सेवामा शोक गर्नेहरूलाई सम्बोधन गरे। जीएमपीकी निकोला ह्युजेसको कफिन म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा बोक्दा दुई प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू रोए। बेलायती प्रहरीले म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा आफ्नी सहकर्मी पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टि अघि भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया देखाए। प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू र सर्वसाधारण जनता पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टि हेर्न बाहिर उभिए। माउन्टेड प्रहरी अधिकारीहरूले पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको कफिन म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा बोक्दा सलामी दिए। मारिएकी महिला प्रहरी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टि सेवाको लागि प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू आइपुगे, समुदायसँग एकताबद्ध भए। म्यानचेस्टरमा उनको अन्त्येष्टि पछि क्याथेड्रलबाट मारिएकी महिला प्रहरी निकोला ह्युजेसलाई बोकेको शव वाहन चलाएर लगियो, उल्लेखनीय दृश्यहरू देखियो। ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर पुलिस कन्स्टेबल निकोला ह्युजेसको कफिन म्यानचेस्टरमा उनको अन्त्येष्टि सेवा पछि म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलबाट बाहिर बोकियो, जहाँ उनी आराम गर्न राखिएको थियो। जीएमपी अधिकारीहरूले उनको प्रहरी टोपी कफिनको माथि राखेर पाल-वाहकको रूपमा काम गरे, जुन क्याथेड्रल गायकदलले गाएको पाई जेसुमा लगिएको थियो। प्रहरी पादरी किथ स्टीवर्टले भने, 'उनी धेरै सम्मानित थिइन् र उनका सहकर्मीहरूले उनलाई मित्रवत, जीवनले भरिएको, सधैं मद्दत गर्न इच्छुक, उत्सुक, साहसी र कुराकानी गर्ने व्यक्तिको रूपमा वर्णन गर्थे।' ओल्डहम, ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टरकी पीसी ह्युजेस २००९ मा जीएमपीमा सामेल भइन्। उनको परिवारले भन्यो कि उनी फरक पार्न चाहन्थिन् र आफूले मन पराएको काम गरिरहेकी थिइन्। साथी अधिकारीहरूले उनलाई कुराकानी गर्ने, सधैं मुस्कुराउने, हँसिलो, संक्रामक व्यक्तित्व भएको व्यक्तिको रूपमा वर्णन गरे। देशव्यापी बलहरूका अधिकारीहरूले जीएमपी सहकर्मीहरूको सिफ्ट कभर गर्न स्वयंसेवा गरे ताकि उनीहरू म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा सेवामा उपस्थित हुन सकून्, जसमध्ये धेरैजसो अन्त्येष्टि जुलुस मार्गमा लामबद्ध थिए। प्रमुख कन्स्टेबलहरू र इङ्गल्याण्ड र वेल्स भरिका बलहरूका वरिष्ठ अधिकारीहरू क्याथेड्रल भित्र पीसी ह्युजेसको परिवार, साथीहरू र सहकर्मीहरूसँगै १,००० शोक गर्नेहरूमध्ये थिए। प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू र सर्वसाधारण जनता सेवाको क्रममा म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रल बाहिर उभिए, एक भएर। ओल्डहमकी महिला प्रहरी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टि सेवा म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा सम्पन्न भयो। ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर पुलिसकी निकोला ह्युजेसको जीवनलाई श्रद्धाञ्जली दिन दर्शकहरू डरलाग्दो शान्त वातावरणमा सडकमा लामबद्ध भए। म्यानचेस्टरमा महिला प्रहरी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टिका लागि प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू भेला भए, सेवाको तालिका अनुसार। प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू र सर्वसाधारण जनता डीन्सगेटमा अन्त्येष्टि अघि सडकमा लामबद्ध भए, सँगै उभिए। पीसी ह्युजेसको पूर्ण आकारको तस्बिर चर्चको अगाडि राखिएको थियो। केही शोक गर्नेहरू - सर्वसाधारण जनता र प्रहरी - भजन गाउँदा र कविताहरू पढ्दा मौन आँसु पुछ्दै थिए। जीएमपी प्रमुख कन्स्टेबल सर पिटर फहीले भने, 'उनको परिवार निकोलाको लागि धेरै गर्व गर्थ्यो। उनी एक लडाकु थिइन्। उनीलाई चिन्ने सबैले धेरै सम्झनेछन्। हामी उनको महान बलिदानलाई कहिल्यै बिर्सने छैनौं।' मण्डलीले भजनहरू द लर्ड्स माइ शेफर्ड र इन हेभनली लभ एबिडिङ गाए। पीसी ह्युजेसका सहकर्मीहरूले कविता र बाइबल पाठ गरे। सार्जेन्ट स्टीफन लोभेटले डेथ इज नथिंग एट अल, इन्स्पेक्टर जेन ब्राउनले डोन्ट लेट योर हार्ट्स बी ट्रबल्ड र सार्जेन्ट गोर्डन स्वानले फील नो गिल्ट इन लाफ्टर पढे। प्रहरी पादरी किथ स्टीवर्टले भने कि पीसी ह्युजेसको जन्म १९८८ मा रोयल ओल्डहम अस्पतालमा भएको थियो, स्याडलवर्थ हाई स्कूलमा पढेकी थिइन् र प्रहरी सेवामा सामेल हुनु अघि हडर्सफील्ड विश्वविद्यालयमा गएकी थिइन्। उनले शोक गर्नेहरूलाई ‘एक जीवन्त युवती’ लाई सम्झन आग्रह गरे जो कराटेमा ग्रीन बेल्ट थिइन् तर आफ्नो नङ र कपालको हेरचाह गर्न पनि मन पराउँथिन् र जसमा अझै पनि ‘सानो केटीको झलक’ थियो। म्यानचेस्टरमा मारिएकी महिला प्रहरी पीसी निकोला ह्युजेसको अन्त्येष्टिका लागि प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू भेला भए, उनलाई सम्झँदै। बच्चाहरू खेले, प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रलमा अन्त्येष्टि अघि सडकमा लामबद्ध भएर भावना व्यक्त गर्दै। एक शोक गर्नेले प्रहरी टेडी बियर समातेका थिए, जबकि ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टर पुलिसको झण्डा अन्त्येष्टि अघि म्यानचेस्टर क्याथेड्रल माथि आधा झुकाइएको थियो, सम्मान दर्शाउँदै। श्री स्टीवर्टले भने, ‘उनी धेरै सम्मानित थिइन् र उनका सहकर्मीहरूले उनलाई मित्रवत, जीवनले भरिएको, सधैं मद्दत गर्न इच्छुक, उत्सुक, साहसी र कुराकानी गर्ने व्यक्तिको रूपमा वर्णन गर्थे।’ पीसी फियोना बोन, ३२, पनि दुखद घटनामा मारिएकी अर्की महिला प्रहरी थिइन्। जीएमपी प्रमुख कन्स्टेबल सर पिटर फहीले भने कि उनी आफ्नो जवान उमेरको बावजुद ‘अविश्वसनीय रूपमा परिपक्व’ थिइन् र ‘अरूको लागि उनको समर्पण’ बाट मृत्यु भयो। उनले भने कि उनको परिवारले गर्वको क्षणको बारेमा बताएका थिए जब हरेक नयाँ अधिकारीले पहिलो पटक आफ्नो वर्दी घर ल्याउँछन्। ‘उनीहरू (अधिकारीहरू) सोच्छन् कि के तिमीले ती जुत्ताहरू भर्न सक्नेछौ,’ उनले भने। ‘निकोलाको हकमा, कहिल्यै कुनै शंका थिएन। उनले दर्शक नबन्ने निर्णय गरिन्। निकोला र फियोना (बोन) लाई थाहा थियो कि प्रहरी सेवाले महिला अधिकारीहरूबाट पुरुष अधिकारीहरू जस्तै अपेक्षा गर्दछ।' उनले भने कि पीसी ह्युजेसले आफूलाई खतरामा पार्ने जान्दा पनि हस्ताक्षर गरिन् र निशस्त्र प्रहरी बल ‘रणनीतिक विकल्प’ थिएन तर यो ‘न्यूनतम बलप्रतिको हाम्रो प्रतिबद्धताको केन्द्र’ थियो। ‘निकोला, उनको समर्पण र व्यावसायिकतामा, उनले आफ्नो कर्तव्य निर्वाह गर्ने तरिकाले, यो देखाइन् कि प्रहरी सेवा शारीरिक बलको बारेमा होइन तर तर्क, संयम र बुद्धिको बारेमा हो,’ उनले भने। ‘उनको परिवार निकोलाको लागि धेरै गर्व गर्थ्यो। उनी एक लडाकु थिइन्। उनीलाई चिन्ने सबैले धेरै सम्झनेछन्। हामी उनको महान बलिदानलाई कहिल्यै बिर्सने छैनौं।' बाहिर भेला भएका सयौं मानिसहरूका लागि क्याथेड्रलको पछाडि एउटा ठूलो स्क्रिनले अन्त्येष्टि प्रसारण गरिरहेको थियो। डेल क्रेगन, २९, हाल दुवै महिला प्रहरी, बुबा र छोरा डेभिड र मार्क शर्ट - र चार हत्या प्रयासको आरोपमा हिरासतमा छन्। पीसी बोनको अन्त्येष्टि भोलि सोही स्थानमा हुनेछ। बुधबार अन्त्येष्टि जुलुसमा चित्रित यो महिला प्रहरी, सेप्टेम्बर १९ मा ग्रेटर म्यानचेस्टरमा दुई महिला प्रहरी मारिएको ठाउँ नजिकै फूल बिछ्याउँदै गरेको पनि देखिएकी थिइन्, अहिले र त्यतिबेलाको अवस्था। पीसी निकोला ह्युजेस, २३, जो मारिएका दुई article_content: Anastasia Strashevskaya, an 18-year-old law student from Novosibirsk, Siberia, has been awarded the title of "Miss Longest Legs Russia". Strashevskaya's legs measure 106cm in length. She won the title in a national beauty contest, outcompeting 52 other participants and receiving a £1,600 prize. The competition included categories such as Miss Bikini, Miss Sport, Miss Smile, and Miss Blonde. Another contestant from Siberia, Benazir Zhamalova, 20, also a student in Novosibirsk, was named Miss Brunette. Strashevskaya, who studies at the Novosibirsk Institute of Law, stated that she is committed to her legal career and will not be sidetracked by modeling opportunities despite her newfound fame. She expressed her lifelong ambition to become a lawyer specializing in civil law. Strashevskaya intends to use part of her prize money to buy a gift for her parents and donate a portion to children with cancer. In an interview with The Siberian Times, she shared her joy and described the victory as a dream come true. She mentioned that her family is very proud and that her friends were supportive of her participation in the competition.

article_content: In Washington, CNN reported that President Bush conveyed his "profound concern" and regret to Iraq's Prime Minister regarding the disrespectful handling of a Quran by a U.S. soldier, as stated by the White House on Tuesday. President Bush contacted Nuri al-Maliki about this event, according to al-Maliki's office.  This conversation occurred after a prior meeting in September. National Security Council representative Gordon Johndroe mentioned that Bush spoke with Iraqi Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki on Monday during one of their regularly planned, secure video conferences. "President Bush voiced his serious worry about what happened and informed Prime Minister Maliki that the soldier has been disciplined by his superiors and taken out of Iraq," Johndroe explained. Al-Maliki's office announced on Tuesday that Bush offered an apology on behalf of the United States for the soldier's actions and "promised to bring the soldier before a court." They added that Bush made this apology during a call to al-Maliki on Tuesday morning. An American staff sergeant, who was a sniper section leader, had used a Quran for target practice in Iraq earlier in May. The U.S. commander in Baghdad officially apologized on Saturday and recited a letter of apology from the soldier responsible. The sergeant has been removed from his position as section leader "with prejudice," formally reprimanded by his commanding general, dismissed from his regiment, and reassigned to the United States, the U.S. military confirmed.  Reports of the Quran being disrespected have angered Muslims in Iraq and globally. Villagers reported that the soldier, whose identity has not been disclosed, shot at a Quran on May 9. The Quran involved in the incident was discovered two days later, the military stated. A tribal leader described "the criminal act by U.S. forces" as occurring at a shooting range at the Radhwaniya police station, located on the western edge of Baghdad. After the soldiers departed, an Iraqi police officer found a target marked in the middle of the Quran, which was riddled with bullets. Photos of the Quran show several bullet holes and an offensive word written on one of its pages. Officials mentioned that the soldier claimed he was unaware it was a Quran, but U.S. authorities dismissed this claim. On Saturday, Maj. Gen. Jeffery Hammond, the U.S. forces commander in Baghdad, appeared with leaders from Radhwaniya and apologized. "I am here before you to ask for your forgiveness," Hammond told tribal leaders and others present at the ceremony. "In the most humble way, I look into your eyes today and ask you to please forgive me and my soldiers." Hammond also read a letter from the soldier, who called his actions "careless, very thoughtless and irresponsible," but insisted he did not intend to be malicious. "I sincerely hope my actions have not damaged the partnership our two nations have built together," the letter stated. Hammond described the soldier's actions as equivalent to "criminal behavior." "I came to this country to protect you, to support you -- not to harm you -- and this soldier's behavior was completely wrong and unacceptable," the general said. Another military official kissed a Quran and presented it as "a humble gift" to the tribal leaders. Many Iraqi leaders indicated that an apology alone would not be enough. On Monday, the Iraqi Islamic Party, associated with Vice President Tariq al-Hashimi, condemned what they called a "clear attack on the sacred things of Muslims everywhere." The party expressed that they received the news "with deep anger and outrage" and want the "harshest possible punishments" for the act. "What truly worries us is the recurrence of these offenses, similar to past incidents where mosques were destroyed and pages of the holy Quran were torn and misused in shameful ways by U.S. soldiers," al-Hashimi stated. "I have requested that, firstly, this apology be officially documented; secondly, a guarantee from the U.S. military to impose the maximum possible punishment on this soldier, so it serves as a warning to other soldiers in the future."
translated_content: वासिङ्टन (सिएनएन) - अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति बुशले इराकका प्रधानमन्त्रीलाई अमेरिकी सैनिकद्वारा कुरानको अपमान गरेकोमा "गहिरो चिन्ता" र दुःख व्यक्त गरेका छन्, ह्वाइट हाउसले मङ्गलबार जनाएको छ। राष्ट्रपति बुशले नुरी अल-मलिकीलाई घटनाको बारेमा फोन गरे, अल-मलिकीको कार्यालयले भने। नेताहरूलाई सेप्टेम्बरमा भेटेका थिए। राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषदका प्रवक्ता गोर्डन जोनड्रोले बुशले इराकी प्रधानमन्त्री नुरी अल-मलिकीसँग सोमबार उनीहरूको नियमित रूपमा निर्धारित सुरक्षित भिडियो टेलिकन्फरेन्स मध्ये एकमा कुरा गरेको बताए। "राष्ट्रपति बुशले घटनाप्रति गहिरो चिन्ता व्यक्त गरे र प्रधानमन्त्री मलिकीलाई सैनिकलाई उनका कमाण्डरहरूले हप्काएका छन् र इराकबाट हटाइएको छ," जोनड्रोले भने। अल-मलिकीको कार्यालयले मङ्गलबार भन्यो कि बुशले संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाको तर्फबाट कार्यको लागि माफी मागे र "सैनिकलाई अदालतमा पेश गर्ने वाचा गरे।" कार्यालयले भन्यो कि बुशले मलिकीलाई मङ्गलबार बिहान फोन गरेर माफी मागेका थिए। अमेरिकी स्टाफ सार्जेन्ट - एक स्नाइपर सेक्सन नेता - ले यस महिनाको सुरुमा इराकमा लक्ष्य अभ्यासको लागि कुरान प्रयोग गरे। बगदादमा अमेरिकी कमाण्डरले शनिबार औपचारिक माफी मागे र दोषी सैनिकद्वारा माफी पत्र पढे। सैनिकलाई सेक्सन नेताको पदबाट "पूर्वाग्रह सहित" हटाइएको छ, आधिकारिक रूपमा उनको कमान्डिङ जनरलले हप्काएका छन्, उनको रेजिमेन्टबाट बर्खास्त गरिएको छ र संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा पुन: तैनाथ गरिएको छ, अमेरिकी सेनाले भन्यो। कुरानको अपमानको रिपोर्टले इराक र विश्वभरका मुस्लिमहरूलाई क्रोधित बनाएको छ। गाउँलेले भने कि सैनिक, जसको नाम सार्वजनिक गरिएको छैन, मे ९ मा कुरानमा गोली हानेका थिए। घटनामा प्रयोग भएको कुरान दुई दिनपछि फेला परेको सेनाले जनाएको छ। एक जनजाति नेताले भने "अमेरिकी सेनाद्वारा गरिएको आपराधिक कार्य" बगदादको पश्चिमी बाहिरी इलाकामा रहेको राधवानिया प्रहरी चौकीमा भएको शूटिंग दायरामा भएको थियो। शूटरहरू गएपछि, एक इराकी प्रहरीले बुलेटले भरिएको कुरानको बीचमा चिन्ह लगाइएको लक्ष्य फेला पारे। कुरानका तस्बिरहरूले धेरै बुलेट प्वालहरू र यसको एक पृष्ठमा लेखिएको अपशब्द देखाउँदछ। अधिकारीहरूले भने कि सैनिकले पुस्तक कुरान हो भनेर थाहा नभएको दाबी गरे, तर अमेरिकी अधिकारीहरूले दाबी अस्वीकार गरे। शनिबार, बगदादमा अमेरिकी सेनाका कमाण्डर मेजर जनरल जेफरी ह्यामन्ड राधवानियाका नेताहरूसँग देखा परे र माफी मागे। "म यहाँ तपाईंसमक्ष क्षमा माग्न आएको छु," ह्यामन्डले जनजाति नेताहरू र समारोहमा उपस्थित अन्यहरूलाई भने। "सबैभन्दा विनम्र ढंगले म आज तपाईंका आँखामा हेर्छु र म भन्छु कृपया मलाई र मेरा सैनिकहरूलाई माफ गर्नुहोस्।" ह्यामन्डले दोषी सैनिकको एउटा पत्र पनि पढे, जसले आफ्नो कार्यलाई "अदूरदर्शी, धेरै लापरवाह र गैरजिम्मेवार" भने, तर उनले दुर्भावनापूर्ण नभएको बताए। "म इमानदारीपूर्वक आशा गर्दछु कि मेरो कार्यले हाम्रो दुई राष्ट्रले सँगै विकास गरेको साझेदारीलाई कम गरेको छैन," पत्रमा भनिएको छ। ह्यामन्डले सैनिकको कार्यलाई "आपराधिक व्यवहार" को बराबर भने। "म तपाईंको रक्षा गर्न, तपाईंलाई समर्थन गर्न - तपाईंलाई हानि नगर्न - यो भूमिमा आएको छु - र यो सैनिकको व्यवहार गलत र अस्वीकार्य भन्दा कम थिएन," जनरलले भने। अर्का सैन्य अधिकारीले कुरानलाई चुम्बन गरे र यसलाई जनजाति नेताहरूलाई "विनम्र उपहार" को रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरे। धेरै इराकी नेताहरूले माफी मात्र पर्याप्त नहुने बताए। सोमबार, इराकी इस्लामिक पार्टी, उपराष्ट्रपति तारिक अल-हाशिमीको आन्दोलनले "विश्वभरका मुस्लिमहरूको पवित्रतामाथि स्पष्ट आक्रमण" भनेर निन्दा गर्‍यो। पार्टीले भन्यो कि यसले समाचारलाई "गहिरो आक्रोश र आक्रोश" संग प्रतिक्रिया दियो र कार्यको लागि "कठोरतम सजाय" चाहन्छ। "हामीलाई वास्तवमा चिन्ता लाग्ने कुरा यी अपराधहरूको पुनरावृत्ति हो जुन विगतमा मस्जिदहरू ध्वस्त पारिएको थियो र पवित्र कुरानका पृष्ठहरू च्यातेर अमेरिकी सैनिकहरूद्वारा अपमानजनक कार्यहरूको लागि प्रयोग गरिएको थियो," अल-हाशिमीले भने। "मैले अनुरोध गरेको छु कि पहिलो यो माफी आधिकारिक रूपमा दस्तावेज गरियोस्; दोस्रो अमेरिकी सेनाबाट यस सैनिकलाई अधिकतम सम्भव सजाय दिनको लागि ग्यारेन्टी ताकि यो भविष्यमा बाँकी सैनिकहरूको लागि निवारक हुनेछ।"

article_content: Editor's Warning: This report is about the rapper Nas and his controversial album. It contains language you may find offensive, including the n-word, which was originally the title of the album. Since this story is about his use of the word in his songs but not on his album, if you continue reading, we must warn you that we have included the word in the story. Nas, 34, says he thinks he can still deliver his message without naming his album what he originally intended. (CNN) -- When Nas said he did not name his album "Nigger" because there might be problems getting it into stores, it was no surprise. But when he indicated that pressure from black leaders also played a role, it seemed uncharacteristic. The Queens-raised rapper has never been one to kowtow. Just last month, he referred to the Rev. Jesse Jackson as "the biggest player hater" and declared Jackson's time as a voice for black America over. But in a recent CNN interview, Nasir Jones explained he did not change the album's name merely to please the Rev. Al Sharpton and other black leaders. Rather, he felt they were overshadowing his message. "I don't think I liked the attention I was getting from some of the elders in my community," he said. "I saw it kind of leaning toward being about them ... only about them. I kind of wanted to just shake that off of me." Hear Nas discuss the controversy » . His remedy? To drop the title altogether -- literally. The album, out Wednesday, has no name. But don't think Nas is cowering from controversy -- the cover features the rapper shirtless with his iconic, gothic "N" digitally whipped into his back. With a host of racial issues -- the Jena Six, Don Imus, nooses -- recently fresh on America's mind, naming an album "Nigger" seemed ill-advised. Nas, however, said his goal was not to upset; it was to challenge a society that focuses more on pejoratives than the racial plights that produce them. "There's still so much wrong in the whole world with people -- poor people, people of color -- I just felt like a nice watch couldn't take that away, make me forget about that. A nice day on a yacht with rich friends couldn't make me forget about reality, what's going on," he said. "That's why I named the album that -- not just that the word is horrible, but the history behind the word, and how it relates to me, how it's affected me, offended me." Harvard law professor Randall Kennedy delves into the frustrating duality of the slur in his 2003 bestseller, "Nigger: The Strange Career of a Troublesome Word." Since colonist John Rolfe first used "negar" in 1619, referring to a shipment of Africans to Virginia, the epithet has largely had a negative connotation, with one exception, Kennedy writes. "Currently, some people insist upon distinguishing nigger -- which they see as exclusively an insult -- from nigga, which they view as a term capable of signaling friendly salutation," Kennedy writes. Kennedy, who is black, concludes his book expressing satisfaction that the word's use causes anxiety. Politicians should avoid uttering it at all costs, he writes, and its use by non-black individuals is generally unacceptable. But never underestimate the word's complexities, says Kennedy: "For bad and for good, nigger is thus destined to remain with us for many years to come -- a reminder of the ironies and the dilemmas, the tragedies and glories, of the American experience." Kennedy declined to comment for this story, and Sharpton's press office did not respond to an e-mail and voice message requesting an interview. Because Nas rescinded the title does not mean the multiplatinum rapper is not prepared to engage in debate on the word's merit in today's lexicon. "It's all about the intent and what you mean and how it's coming off and the reason why you're saying it. You know, if it's ill intent, if you're angry, ignorant, meanspirited, saying that word -- it means the worst," he explained. "If you're just a couple of black guys on the street corner, it doesn't mean it's a great thing, but it's not that they're trying to harm each other when they say it." As for a wholesale ban on the word -- something Jackson and Sharpton have suggested -- Nas scoffed. "For some people, you should never be able to use it," he said. "For others, it's way too late. It's too late to try to stop using it. It's something that's just part of the language now." That "elders" had anything to do with changing the album's name might be a sign the 34-year-old is continuing the personal growth so easily charted since he released his 1994 debut, "Illmatic," an album that would help earn him the No. 5 spot on MTV's list of the top MCs of all time. Back then, Nas was a 20-year-old, street-hustling rhymesmith from the rough-and-tumble Queensbridge projects, on the brink of earning the admiration of some of hip-hop's biggest names. He has been called "the king" (Producer Dallas Austin), "a genius" (Island Def Jam Chairman L.A. Reid) and "the greatest rapper of all time" (rapper Kanye West). After "Illmatic," fans watched Nas -- and his ego -- grow through the years as he proclaimed himself "Nastradamus," "God's Son" and the "Street's Disciple." His legions watched him become jaded with age when, in 2006, he declared, "Hip Hop is Dead," and criticized the rappers and DJs he felt had made the genre stale. Though Nas had dabbled in advocacy before Wednesday, his lyrics more often focused on his rhyming skills, fashionable sneakers, women, and marijuana. Violence was frequently mentioned, especially towards any would-be detractors. On the untitled album, there is still a militant tone, with threats of violence directed at those who seek to oppress African-Americans. He draws parallels to Black Panther founder Huey P. Newton and threatens to use Molotov cocktails, referencing civil rights murder victim Emmett Till. On "Testify," Nas warns that he is loading a magazine to "send these redneck bigots some death in a bag/choke him out with his Confederate flag/I know these devils are mad." "I really like 'Testify' because it's like a man who's just frustrated and doesn't know how to fight. It's when you feel like there's no one to call. Who do you call when you're of the ethnic group that the police have been wiping out for years and the government doesn't do anything?" Nas asked. Nas explains his growth on "Project Roach," crediting a Guyanese anthropologist and literary critic with helping him mature: "I used to worship a certain Queens police murderer/Till I read the words of Ivan Van Sertima/He inserted something in me that made me feel worthier/Now I spit revolution, I'm his hood interpreter." Other messages on the album seem designed to inspire the black community or to denounce a separate-but-equal culture that claims to foster fairness but rarely delivers results. On "America," he comments, "Too many rappers, athletes and actors/But not enough niggas in NASA/Who gives you the latest dances, trends and fashion?/But when it comes to residuals they look past us." Nas acknowledged he is a different person today than when he released "Illmatic," and his music has evolved with him. Fans should recognize and appreciate this evolution rather than making comparisons, he said. He tentatively agreed that his untitled album addresses the plight of black America with a more positive voice, but he almost bristled when asked if he was a "conscious rapper," like Common, Mos Def and Talib Kweli, who largely avoid topics of violence and misogyny. Nas, he said, will remain an individual, an artist, a lyricist, whose style and message cannot be neatly categorized like one of his albums. "I just look at myself as a man who's trying to figure things out in the world, and God is amazing because He's never going to let us figure it all out," Nas said. "So I don't really have a category. I'm just a man who's in search, who's always in search, who's always going to question things, you know?"
translated_content: सम्पादकको चेतावनी: यो रिपोर्ट र्‍यापर नास र उनको विवादास्पद एल्बमको बारेमा हो। यसमा तपाईंलाई आपत्तिजनक लाग्न सक्ने भाषा समावेश छ, जसमा एन-शब्द पनि समावेश छ, जुन मूलतः एल्बमको शीर्षक थियो। यो कथा उनको गीतमा तर उनको एल्बममा नभएको शब्दको प्रयोगको बारेमा भएकोले, यदि तपाईं पढ्न जारी राख्नुहुन्छ भने, हामी तपाईंलाई चेतावनी दिनुपर्छ कि हामीले कथामा त्यो शब्द समावेश गरेका छौं। नास, ३४, भन्छन् कि उनले आफ्नो एल्बमलाई सुरुमा सोचेको नाम नराखीकन पनि आफ्नो सन्देश दिन सक्छन्। (CNN) -- जब नासले भने कि उनले आफ्नो एल्बमको नाम "निगर" राखेनन् किनभने यसलाई स्टोरहरूमा ल्याउन समस्या हुन सक्छ, यो कुनै आश्चर्य थिएन। तर जब उनले संकेत गरे कि काला नेताहरूको दबाबले पनि भूमिका खेलेको थियो, यो अस्वाभाविक लाग्यो। क्वीन्समा हुर्केका र्‍यापर कहिल्यै कसैको अगाडि झुक्ने व्यक्ति थिएनन्। गत महिना मात्र, उनले रेभ. जेसी ज्याक्सनलाई "सबैभन्दा ठूलो प्लेयर हेटर" भने र ज्याक्सनको समय काला अमेरिकाको लागि आवाजको रूपमा समाप्त भएको घोषणा गरे। तर हालैको CNN अन्तर्वार्तामा, नासिर जोन्सले बताए कि उनले एल्बमको नाम रेभ. अल शार्प्टन र अन्य काला नेताहरूलाई खुसी पार्नको लागि मात्र परिवर्तन गरेका होइनन्। बरु, उनले महसुस गरे कि उनीहरूले उनको सन्देशलाई ओझेलमा पारिरहेका थिए। "मलाई लाग्दैन कि मैले मेरो समुदायका केही अग्रजहरूबाट पाइरहेको ध्यान मलाई मन पर्यो," उनले भने। "मैले यो उनीहरूको बारेमा मात्र भएको जस्तो देखेँ ... केवल उनीहरूको बारेमा। म त्यो कुरा आफूबाट हटाउन चाहन्थें।" नासको विवादको बारेमा सुन्नुहोस् »। उनको समाधान? शीर्षक पूर्ण रूपमा हटाउनु -- शाब्दिक रूपमा। बुधवार रिलिज भएको एल्बमको कुनै नाम छैन। तर नास विवादबाट डराएको नसोच्नुहोस् -- कभरमा र्‍यापर शर्टलेस र उनको प्रतिष्ठित, गोथिक "एन" डिजिटल रूपमा उनको ढाडमा कोरिएको छ। जातीय मुद्दाहरूको भीड -- जेना सिक्स, डन इमस, फाँसीको डोरी -- हालै अमेरिकाको दिमागमा ताजा हुँदा, एल्बमको नाम "निगर" राख्नु अनुचित देखिन्थ्यो। नासले, तथापि, भने कि उनको लक्ष्य कसैलाई दुखी पार्नु थिएन; यो एक समाजलाई चुनौती दिनु थियो जसले जातीय पीडाहरू उत्पादन गर्ने जातीय पीडाहरू भन्दा अपमानजनक शब्दहरूमा बढी ध्यान दिन्छ। "अझै पनि संसारमा मानिसहरूसँग धेरै गलत छ -- गरीब मानिसहरू, रङका मानिसहरू -- मैले भर्खरै महसुस गरें कि एउटा राम्रो घडीले त्यो टाढा लैजान सक्दैन, मलाई त्यो बिर्सिन सक्दैन। धनी साथीहरूसँग याटमा एक राम्रो दिनले मलाई वास्तविकता, के भइरहेको छ, बिर्सिन सक्दैन," उनले भने। "त्यसैले मैले एल्बमको नाम त्यो राखेँ -- केवल त्यो शब्द डरलाग्दो छ भनेर मात्र होइन, तर शब्दको पछाडिको इतिहास, र यो मसँग कसरी सम्बन्धित छ, यसले मलाई कसरी असर गरेको छ, अपमानित गरेको छ।" हार्वर्ड कानूनका प्रोफेसर रान्डल केनेडीले २००३ को आफ्नो बेस्टसेलर "निगर: द स्ट्रेन्ज करियर अफ अ ट्रबलसम वर्ड" मा अपमानको निराशाजनक द्वैधताको बारेमा खोजी गरेका छन्। औपनिवेशिक जोन रोल्फले १६१९ मा पहिलो पटक "नेगर" प्रयोग गरेदेखि, भर्जिनियामा अफ्रिकीहरूको ढुवानीलाई जनाउँदै, यो शब्द धेरै हदसम्म नकारात्मक अर्थमा प्रयोग भएको छ, एउटा अपवाद बाहेक, केनेडी लेख्छन्। "हालसालै, केही मानिसहरू निगरलाई छुट्याउन जोड दिन्छन् -- जसलाई उनीहरूले विशेष रूपमा अपमानको रूपमा देख्छन् -- निगाबाट, जसलाई उनीहरूले मैत्री अभिवादनको संकेत गर्न सक्षम शब्दको रूपमा हेर्छन्," केनेडी लेख्छन्। केनेडी, जो काला हुन्, आफ्नो पुस्तकमा सन्तुष्टि व्यक्त गर्दै निष्कर्ष निकाल्छन् कि यो शब्दको प्रयोगले चिन्ता उत्पन्न गर्दछ। राजनीतिज्ञहरूले यसलाई कुनै पनि हालतमा उच्चारण नगर्नुपर्छ, उनी लेख्छन्, र गैर-अश्वेत व्यक्तिहरूद्वारा यसको प्रयोग सामान्यतया अस्वीकार्य छ। तर शब्दको जटिलतालाई कहिल्यै कम नआँक्नुहोस्, केनेडी भन्छन्: "नराम्रो र राम्रोको लागि, निगर यसरी आउने धेरै वर्षसम्म हामीसँग रहन निश्चित छ -- अमेरिकी अनुभवको विडम्बना र दुविधाहरू, त्रासदीहरू र महिमाहरूको सम्झना दिलाउने।" केनेडीले यस कथाको लागि टिप्पणी गर्न अस्वीकार गरे, र शार्प्टनको प्रेस अफिसले अन्तर्वार्ताको लागि अनुरोध गर्दै इ-मेल र भ्वाइस सन्देशको जवाफ दिएन। किनभने नासले शीर्षक रद्द गरे, यसको मतलब यो होइन कि मल्टिप्लेटिनम र्‍यापर आजको शब्दकोशमा शब्दको औचित्यमा बहस गर्न तयार छैनन्। "यो सबै नियत, तपाईँको अर्थ, र यो कसरी आइरहेको छ र तपाईँ किन भन्दै हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने बारेमा हो। तपाईँलाई थाहा छ, यदि यो खराब नियत हो भने, यदि तपाईँ क्रोधित हुनुहुन्छ, अज्ञानी हुनुहुन्छ, दुष्ट हुनुहुन्छ, त्यो शब्द भन्दै हुनुहुन्छ -- यसको अर्थ सबैभन्दा खराब हो," उनले व्याख्या गरे। "यदि तपाईँ सडकको कुनामा केही अश्वेत युवाहरू हुनुहुन्छ भने, यसको मतलब यो राम्रो कुरा होइन, तर यसको मतलब यो होइन कि तिनीहरूले एकअर्कालाई हानि पुर्‍याउने प्रयास गरिरहेका छन् जब तिनीहरूले यो भन्छन्।" शब्दमा पूर्ण प्रतिबन्धको लागि -- ज्याक्सन र शार्प्टनले सुझाव दिएका कुरा -- नासले हाँसो उडाए। "केही मानिसहरूका लागि, तपाईँले यसलाई कहिल्यै प्रयोग गर्न सक्षम हुनुहुँदैन," उनले भने। "अरूहरूका लागि, यो धेरै ढिलो भइसकेको छ। यसलाई प्रयोग गर्न छोड्न प्रयास गर्न धेरै ढिलो भइसकेको छ। यो यस्तो चीज हो जुन अहिले भाषाको हिस्सा हो।" "अग्रजहरू" को एल्बमको नाम परिवर्तन गर्नमा केही भूमिका थियो भन्ने संकेत हुन सक्छ कि ३४ वर्षीयले आफ्नो १९९४ को पहिलो एल्बम "इलमेटिक" रिलिज गरेदेखि सजिलै देख्न सकिने व्यक्तिगत विकासलाई निरन्तरता दिइरहेका छन्, जुन एल्बमले उनलाई MTV को शीर्ष MCs को सूचीमा नम्बर ५ स्थान कमाउन मद्दत गर्‍यो। त्यतिबेला, नास २० वर्षीय, सडकमा संघर्ष गर्ने कवि क्वीन्सब्रिज परियोजनाहरूबाट थिए, हिप-हपका केही ठूला नामहरूको प्रशंसा कमाउने क्रममा। उनलाई "राजा" (निर्माता डलास अस्टिन), "प्रतिभा" (आइल्याण्ड डेफ जामका अध्यक्ष एल.ए. रीड) र "सबै समयका महानतम र्‍यापर" (र्‍यापर कान्ये वेस्ट) भनिएको छ। "इलमेटिक" पछि, प्रशंसकहरूले नास -- र उनको अहंकार -- वर्षौंदेखि बढेको देखे जब उनले आफूलाई "नास्ट्राडमस," "भगवानको छोरा" र "स्ट्रीट्स डिसाइपल" भनेर घोषणा गरे। उनका प्रशंसकहरूले उनलाई उमेरसँगै निराश भएको देखे जब, २००६ मा, उनले घोषणा गरे, "हिप हप इज डेड," र र्‍यापरहरू र डीजेहरूको आलोचना गरे जसलाई उनले यो विधालाई पुरानो बनाएको महसुस गरे। यद्यपि नासले बुधवार अघि वकालतमा संलग्न भएका थिए, तर उनका गीतहरू प्रायः उनको कविता क्षमता, फेसनल जुत्ता, महिलाहरू र गाँजामा केन्द्रित थिए। हिंसा बारम्बार उल्लेख गरिएको थियो, विशेष गरी कुनै पनि सम्भावित आलोचकहरूको लागि। शीर्षकविहीन एल्बममा, अझै पनि एक लडाकु भावना छ, हिंसाको धम्कीहरू अफ्रिकी-अमेरिकीहरूलाई उत्पीडन गर्न खोज्नेहरूमा निर्देशित छन्। उनले ब्ल्याक प्यान्थरका संस्थापक ह्यु पी. न्यूटनसँग समानताहरू देखाउँछन् र मोलोटोभ ककटेल प्रयोग गर्ने धम्की दिन्छन्, नागरिक अधिकार हत्या पीडित एम्मेट टिललाई सन्दर्भ गर्दै। "टेस्टिफाई" मा, नासले चेतावनी दिन्छन् कि उनी "यी रेडनेक कट्टरपन्थीहरूलाई झोलामा केही मृत्यु पठाउन/उसलाई उसको कन्फेडेरेट झण्डाले निसास्साउन/मलाई थाहा छ यी शैतानहरू पागल छन्" भनेर म्यागजिन लोड गर्दैछन्। "मलाई 'टेस्टिफाई' साँच्चै मन पर्छ किनभने यो यस्तो लाग्छ कि एक मान्छे जो भर्खरै निराश छ र लड्न जान्दैन। यो तब हुन्छ जब तपाईँलाई लाग्छ कि कसैलाई फोन गर्न कोही छैन। तपाईँले कसलाई फोन गर्नुहुन्छ जब तपाईँ जातीय समूहको हुनुहुन्छ जसलाई पुलिसले वर्षौंदेखि सखाप पारेको छ र सरकारले केहि गर्दैन?" नासले सोधे। नासले "प्रोजेक्ट रोच" मा आफ्नो विकासको व्याख्या गर्दछन्, एक गुयानी मानवविज्ञानी र साहित्यिक आलोचकलाई उनलाई परिपक्व हुन मद्दत गरेको "अमेरिका" मा, उनले टिप्पणी गर्दछन्, "धेरै र्‍यापरहरू, खेलाडीहरू र अभिनेताहरू/तर नासामा पर्याप्त अश्वेतहरू छैनन्/कसले तपाईंलाई पछिल्लो नृत्यहरू, प्रचलनहरू र फेसन दिन्छ?/तर जब पारिश्रमिकको कुरा आउँछ तिनीहरूले हामीलाई बेवास्ता गर्छन्।" नासले स्वीकार गरे कि उनी आज "इलमेटिक" रिलिज गर्दा भन्दा फरक व्यक्ति हुन्, र उनको संगीत उनीसँगै विकसित भएको छ। प्रशंसकहरूले यो विकासलाई चिन्न र सराहना गर्नुपर्छ बरु तुलना गर्नु हुँदैन, उनले भने। उनले अस्थायी रूपमा सहमत भए कि उनको शीर्षकविहीन एल्बमले अश्वेत अमेरिकाको दुर्दशालाई अधिक सकारात्मक आवाजले सम्बोधन गर्दछ, तर उनी लगभग रिसाए जब उनलाई "चेतन र्‍यापर" हो कि भनेर सोधियो, कमन, मोस डेफ र तालिब क्वावेली जस्ता, जसले हिंसा र महिला द्वेषको विषयलाई धेरै हदसम्म बेवास्ता गर्छन्। नासले भने, एक व्यक्ति, एक कलाकार, एक गीतकार रहनेछन्, जसको शैली र सन्देशलाई उनको एल्बमहरू मध्ये एक जस्तै सफासँग वर्गीकृत गर्न सकिँदैन। "मैले आफूलाई संसारमा चीजहरू पत्ता लगाउन खोजिरहेको एक व्यक्तिको रूपमा मात्र हेर्छु, र भगवान अद्भुत हुनुहुन्छ किनभने उहाँले हामीलाई कहिल्यै सबै कुरा पत्ता लगाउन दिनुहुने छैन," नासले भने। "त्यसैले मसँग वास्तवमा कुनै वर्ग छैन। म केवल एक मान्छे हुँ जो खोजमा छ, जो सधैं खोजमा छ, जो सधैं चीजहरू प्रश्न गर्न गइरहेको छ, तपाईँलाई थाहा छ?"
